why: §273 · §275 The PDF highlight files are named after the PDF's path under the vault root. The frontend writes them (sidecarPathFor, companionPathFor in src/components/editor/pdf/pdf-highlight-sidecar.ts) and a file rename moves them (index/service/rename/pdf_highlights.rs). Both read this file, so the two rules cannot drift.

cases.why: a PDF in a folder keeps its folders
the extension is matched without regard to ASCII case and replaced by a lower-case one
any other character is kept as it is
